references.text: Interconnected parts of the same prophetic dream that together tell the whole story of seven good and seven bad years.
The interpretation of the lean cows from the source verse as seven coming years of famine.
The dramatic action where the lean cows from the source verse devour the beautiful ones.
The necessary contrast between the beautiful cows (abundance) and the lean ones (scarcity) in the same prophecy.
The vegetable parallel (seven thin ears) that confirms the same prophecy as the lean cows.
